messages.content: You write short, factual encyclopedia-style paragraphs from structured facts. Reply with JSON only, no commentary and no code fences.

Write one sentence per fact below, in the same order, in varied natural prose. Each sentence must contain the subject name and the object name exactly as written, and must state the years given for its fact. Do not add facts, merge facts, or mention anything that is not listed.

F1: Gupu Koduvo | is a member of | Piduese
F2: Gupu Koduvo | works for | Suzo Partners

Reply as JSON: {"sentences": [{"fact": "F1", "text": "..."}, ...]}

response: {"sentences": [{"fact": "F1", "text": "Gupu Koduvo is a member of Piduese."}, {"fact": "F2", "text": "Gupu Koduvo works for Suzo Partners."}]}
